svg.text: GHOSTED: Recruiter Ricky model sheet v1 (Illustrator, 2026-11-25)
Upright, neutral, symmetric turnaround. Body map v1 landmarks. Direction A (bell jacket). Hand-drawn Bezier half outlines lifted to round bodies; palette rows only.

eye line = ear points = cups

3/4 (front turned to viewer-left)
SIDE (facing viewer-left)
BACK
PALETTE (existing rows only, seats/lena-park.md)
17 #2E2C3D suit, trousers
15 #F2C79E skin: head, hands
16 #F8F4EA shirt V, collar, cuffs, teeth
10 #C9A6D6 ACCENT: headset + tie

Shade: base x 0.85 (neutral grey multiplier).
SHAPE RULES
- Toy pawn, 2.67 heads (Kit 2.71). 1.00 m.
- Round head, eye line = ear line = cups.
- Bell jacket: soft shoulders, flares a little.
- Headset: band centred over the crown,
one cup on EACH ear, mic from the right cup.
- Tie centred under the shirt collar, inside
the shirt V. Accent row 10 on both.
- Value break vs Kit: white shirt V, collar
ring, cuffs + the light accent on a dark suit.
- Joins: a shoulder ball at each arm root;
sleeve, then a white cuff, then the hand.
DRAIN (front, same metres): colour drains to white, legs fade, he floats; headset and tie stay on the same landmarks
Ricky
step 1: colour drains, legs fade, lifts
step 2: white, no legs, no mouth, floats
step 3: the locked Ghostie (v7)
(shown with both parts: see notes)
ON THE PHONE: right hand to the right cup
(shoulder ball, elbow out, wrist, hand on the cup)
HOP (like Kit): squash, stretch up, squash
squash only on the bounce (Kit rule)
64 px SILHOUETTE (front, 3/4; 1x and x4)
LINEUP AT THE GAME CAMERA (x2): Ricky estimate on real v7 grass with Kit and 3 Ghosties. Colour, then greyscale (Lena's formula).
GAME CAMERA, NEXT TO KIT (x3, 1x)
suit 17 vs Kit trousers 26: 1.27:1 (close: the risk)
shirt 16 vs suit 17: 12.38:1
accent 10 vs suit 17: 6.42:1
accent 10 vs Kit tie 7 (#D4503A): 1.98:1, hue lilac vs red
accent 10 vs heal orange #F2994A: 1.05:1, hue lilac vs orange
In grey, Ricky reads as a near-black bell with a white V, light cups and light hands; Kit reads as a mid-grey body.
SIZE AT THE GAME CAMERA (open, see notes):
Drawn at the target: 1.05 x Kit's real 72 px
= 76 px tall. My metric estimate (75 px/m)
gives 67 px: the real Kit reaches 13 px above
its own 1 m pole (v7 ingame_report kitTop).
Viet's blockout measures and sets the scale.
